segments.vv40:1.3: Mahiddhike candanaruciragatte, kā tvaṃ subhe devate vandase mamaṃ.
segments.vv40:2.3: Yattha tvaṃ nisinnā virocasi, devarājāriva nandane vane.
segments.vv40:3.1: “Kiṃ tvaṃ pure sucaritamācarī bhadde, kissa kammassa vipākaṃ;
segments.vv40:4.1: “Piṇḍāya te carantassa, mālaṃ phāṇitañca adadaṃ bhante;
segments.vv40:5.1: “Hoti ca me anutāpo, aparaddhaṃ [aparādhaṃ (syā.)] dukkhitañca [dukkaṭañca (sī.)] me bhante;
segments.vv40:6.1: “Taṃ taṃ vadāmi bhaddante,‘yassa me anukampiyo koci;
segments.vv40:7.1: “Yesaṃ atthi saddhā buddhe, dhamme ca saṅgharatane;
segments.vv40:7.3: Te maṃ ativirocanti, āyunā yasasā siriyā.

lines: Tattha pabhassaravaravaṇṇanibheti nibhāti dibbatīti nibhā, vaṇṇova nibhā vaṇṇanibhā, ativiya obhāsanato pabhassarā chavidosābhāvena varā uttamā vaṇṇanibhā etissāti pabhassaravaravaṇṇanibhā.
Candanaruciragatteti candanānulittaṃ viya ruciragatte, gosītacandanena bahalatarānulittaṃ viya surattamanuññasarīrāvayaveti attho, candanānulepena vā ruciragatte.
Evaṃ therena puṭṭhā devatā imāhi gāthāhi byākāsi –
“Piṇḍāya te carantassa, mālaṃ phāṇitañca adadaṃ bhante;
“Hoti ca me anutāpo, aparaddhaṃ dukkhitañca me bhante;
“Taṃ taṃ vadāmi bhaddante, yassa me anukampiyo koci;
“Yesaṃ atthi saddhā buddhe, dhamme ca saṅgharatane;
Te maṃ ativirocanti, āyunā yasasā siriyā.
“Patāpena vaṇṇena uttaritarā, aññe mahiddhikatarā mayā devā”ti.
Idāni taṃ sarūpato dasseti “sāhaṃ dhammaṃ nāssosin”ti, sā ahaṃ tadā tava desetukāmassa dhammaṃ na suṇiṃ.
Sudesitaṃ dhammarājenāti, sammāsambuddhena ādikalyāṇāditāya ekantaniyyānikatāya ca svākhātanti attho.
Tanti tasmā dhammarājena sudesitattā asavanassa ca mādisānaṃ anutāpahetubhāvato.
703-4. Te maṃ ativirocantīti te ratanattaye pasannā devaputtā maṃ atikkamitvā virocanti.
Vaṇṇena uttaritarā mahiddhikatarā ca devā, te ratanattaye abhippasannāyevāti dasseti.
